title: Spoiled Casting
summary: The Cult keeps spare moulds in the Magma Vault. Haldor knows how to spoil a mould where it stands, with a cold chisel on its seam, if somebody holds the floor round the stack long enough.

steps.journal: The Magma Vault, the Cinderworks' second floor: hold five waves by the Cult's spare moulds, long enough to spoil them.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Magma Vault

ready: The Cult's spare moulds are cracked through. Tell Haldor at the Ashgate Forge.
done: Nobody casts anything out of those moulds again. Haldor says it was his chisel.
